description: Source code for managing symbolic shape computation graphs in PyTorch JIT runtime, including registration, validation, and retrieval of shape functions.

methods.name: getInplaceVariant
methods.description: Finds an inplace variant of a given function schema if it exists.

methods.name: mapTensorToListOfInts
methods.description: Maps Tensor types to List[int] types for shape analysis.

methods.name: checkForWhileLoop
methods.description: Checks for while loops in the graph, warns if found.

methods.name: checkInputReturnedAsOutput
methods.description: Ensures inputs are not returned as outputs in the shape graph.

methods.name: checkInputAndOutputTypes
methods.description: Validates input and output types of the shape graph against schema.

methods.name: transformShapeFunction
methods.description: Transforms shape functions, e.g., unpacks tuple outputs.

methods.name: genShapeComputeFn
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a shape compute graph for a schema.

methods.name: registerSchema
methods.description: Registers a shape compute graph for a schema.

methods.name: registerBoundedSchema
methods.description: Registers bounded shape graphs for a schema.

methods.name: loadModule
methods.description: Loads shape functions into the module, registers schemas.

methods.name: loadFunctions
methods.description: Loads all shape functions and initializes the registry.
